56. Humphrey Waylon felt anxious about Drew's growing beauty.

['Drew yelled at Humphrey Waylon, inquiring about the children playing near the fountain.', 'Drew appealed to Humphrey Waylon, asking which way the river flowed from the bridge.', 'Drew called out to Humphrey Waylon, wondering why the lanterns were flickering in the wind.', 'Drew cried out to Humphrey Waylon, asking about the men in the carts.', 'Drew hollered to Humphrey Waylon, probing into the secrets of the old mansion on the hill.', 'Drew shouted at Humphrey Waylon, questioning the whereabouts of the horses in the stable.']

Correct Answer: Drew cried out to Humphrey Waylon, asking about the men in the carts.

Model Response: Drew hollered to Humphrey Waylon, probing into the secrets of the old mansion on the hill.

Is the model response correct? Answer yes or no only.
